candidate_relations.reason: The candidate correctly identifies Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia and notes lobar consolidation, which is consistent with the clinical record. However, the reference diagnosis requires three additional components: (1) 'severe' designation (supported by ICU admission, RR 60, bilateral diffuse infiltrates, plastic bronchitis), (2) coronary artery dilation (echocardiography on day 28 showing RCA z-score 3.8), and (3) necrotizing pneumonia (implied by plastic bronchitis, lobar consolidation pattern, and severity). All three are missing from the candidate, making it an incomplete representation of the full diagnostic object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies MPP with lobar consolidation but omits 'severe' qualifier, coronary artery dilation (CAD), and necrotizing pneumonia components

case_quality_flags: Necrotizing pneumonia component in reference diagnosis is inferred from clinical severity and plastic bronchitis rather than explicitly confirmed by CT necrosis/cavitation documentation in the record
Coronary artery dilation with z-score 3.8 is clearly documented on day 28 echocardiography, supporting CAD component
